nextCharge.title: Next charge
nextCharge.help: 12-hour verdict: charge home now, wait for off-peak, Supercharger, or skip DC-fast.

reason.enough: Battery is at {{soc}}%, already at the {{target}}% target.
reason.wait_offpeak: Wait for off-peak at {{time}} — save {{save}} versus charging now.
reason.supercharger_faster: Home charging cannot finish before ready-by; {{site}} is the cheapest billed Supercharger.
reason.supercharger_cheaper: {{site}} is cheaper ({{sc}} vs {{home}} at home) for the energy you still need.
reason.skip_dc: Skip {{site}} ({{sc}}) — home now is {{home}} for the same energy.
reason.charge_home_now: Charge at home now — the cheapest window is already open (or too far out to wait).
